data.define: Said to show something is perfect, like a great meal.

misuse.text: Don't say 'chef's kiss' about burnt toast.

data.l1_hook: Prove isso e me diga. 'chef's kiss'

native.tip: “chef's kiss” = de dar água na boca. Exemplo: “The soup was chef's kiss.”
native.caption:
O que significa “chef's kiss”?
“chef's kiss” = de dar água na boca.
Exemplo: “The soup was chef's kiss.” (A sopa estava "chef's kiss".)
